blocks.text: MADRID—A Spanish High Court judge has opened an investigation into singer Julio Iglesias following a complaint filed by two former employees in which they alleged sexual offenses, degrading treatment and assault, a court ruling seen by The Associated Press on Wednesday, Nov. 18, said. Rights group Women’s Link Worldwide filed the complaint on behalf of the two women, who alleged that Iglesias had sexually and physically assaulted them in 2021 in his Caribbean residences in which they worked.
